name_zh: 夏目漱石/明治/文豪/近代自我/猫视角/心理剖析
name_en: Natsume Soseki/Meiji/Literary Master/Modern Self/Cat Perspective/Psychological Anatomy
description_zh: 夏目漱石 (1867-1916) 日本近代文学奠基人，《我是猫》《心》《坊津》作者。以'猫视角'拟人化讽刺明治文明病理，'心'完成近代自我心理解剖，留学英国反思文明冲突，提出'then-and-now'文明批评框架，确立私小说心理实验传统。
description_en: Natsume Soseki (1867-1916) Founder of modern Japanese literature, author of I Am a Cat, Kokoro, Botchan. Used 'cat perspective' anthropomorphic satire on Meiji civilization pathology; Kokoro completed modern self psychological anatomy; UK study reflected civilization clash; proposed 'then-and-now' civilization critique framework; established shishosetsu psychological experiment tradition.
reason_zh: 漱石代表'近代自我'如何在文明剧变中通过文学实验完成心理解剖。其'猫视角'将读者置于旁观者位置重审文明荒谬；'心'以师生/父子/夫妻三重背叛完成近代伦理解体图谱；留学反思确立'文明批评'作为知识分子核心使命。私小说传统至今影响村上春树、东野圭吾等。
reason_en: Soseki represents how 'modern self' completes psychological anatomy through literary experiment amid civilization upheaval. 'Cat perspective' places reader as observer re-examining civilization absurdity; Kokoro maps modern ethics disintegration via teacher-student/father-son/husband-wife triple betrayal; UK reflection established 'civilization critique' as intellectuals' core mission. Shishosetsu tradition influences Murakami, Higashino today.
steps_zh: 解构《我是猫》：拟人化讽刺如何将读者置于旁观位置解构文明荒谬
剖析《心》：师生/父子/夫妻三重背叛如何完成近代伦理解体图谱
追溯留学反思：伦敦两年'神经衰弱'如何转化为'then-and-now'文明批评框架
确立私小说：心理实验与自传融合如何开创'我小说'传统
总结漱石模式：猫视角解构→心理剖析解体→文明批评框架→私小说传承的文学认知闭环
steps_en: Deconstruct I Am a Cat: how anthropomorphic satire places reader as observer deconstructing civilization absurdity
Analyze Kokoro: how teacher-student/father-son/husband-wife triple betrayal maps modern ethics disintegration
Trace UK reflection: how two years London 'neurasthenia' transformed into 'then-and-now' civilization critique framework
Establish Shishosetsu: how psychological experiment + autobiography fusion created 'I-novel' tradition
Summarize Soseki pattern: cat perspective deconstruction → psychological anatomy disintegration → civilization critique framework → I-novel tradition cognitive loop
expected_zh: 掌握'猫视角'如何作为文学手术刀解剖文明病理；理解'心'式心理剖析如何完成近代自我伦理拓扑；评估漱石文明批评框架对当代知识分子公共介入的方法论启示。
expected_en: Master how 'cat perspective' serves as literary scalpel dissecting civilization pathology; understand how Kokoro-style psychological anatomy completes modern self ethical topology; evaluate Soseki civilization critique framework's methodological lessons for contemporary intellectuals' public engagement.
case_zh: 1905 《我是猫》连载；1914 《心》发表；1916 病逝未完《明暗》。猫视角-心理剖析-文明批评-私小说范式永存。
case_en: 1905 I Am a Cat serialized; 1914 Kokoro published; 1916 died unfinished Light and Darkness. Cat perspective-psychological anatomy-civilization critique-I-novel paradigm endures.
intellectual_tradition: Modern Japanese Literature / Shishosetsu / Civilization Critique
cross_cultural_impact: Cat perspective satire; psychological anatomy; civilization critique; I-novel tradition; modern self
